Grid.TextBlock:
1. (S) SITUATION:
Signals intelligence indicates Soviet replenishment traffic is moving west of Sumatra to support raider operations around Sunda and Lombok. The patrol box contains a probable support group moving along a marked route, with regional merchant traffic providing possible cover for the movement.
2. (S) MISSION: 2.1 Destroy the Soviet replenishment ship. 2.2 {TaskForceFlagshipName} must survive.
3. (S) EXECUTION: 3.1 Infiltrate the patrol box west of Sumatra and maintain covert surveillance of the probable replenishment route. 3.2 Classify the support group before attacking. Avoid engagement with neutral merchant traffic. 3.3 Destroy the replenishment ship when a favorable firing solution is available, then break contact immediately. 3.4 Proceed to the marked escape area to the southwest and preserve the boat for follow-on operations.
4. (S) ENEMY SITUATION: 4.1 The target is part of a Soviet support group moving along the replenishment route. 4.2 Escort or patrol vessels may be nearby, and the enemy will begin a search once the target is attacked. 4.3 Merchant traffic may obscure the contact picture but must not be engaged.
5. (S) FRIENDLY SITUATION: 5.1 {TaskForceFlagshipName} is operating independently in the patrol box. 5.2 No friendly surface force is assigned to support the attack or cover the withdrawal. 5.3 The escape area is the planned end state and must be reached after the strike.
6. (S) INTEL ASSESSMENT: 6.1 Equatorial haze, broken cloud, and rain showers favor a submerged approach but may make surface radar classification unreliable. 6.2 Removing the replenishment ship will impose immediate endurance constraints on Soviet eastern operations. 6.3 This is a single-pass operation. Once the target is destroyed, remain covert and withdraw rather than search for additional contacts.
